blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM , a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.
blocks.zh: 从稀缺的测量中产生并预测瞬间物理场是具有挑战性的,因为观测不足以描述整个场的分布。 这限制了依赖全域数据集的常规数据驱动传播模型. 我们引入了物理定义的传播框架 PhysDEM, 这个框架将管理方程和空间稀少的观测结合起来, 从而产生多个合理的领域。 首先,我们构建一个吉布斯目标 通过重取一个测量条件的高斯参照物 与PDE剩余能量。 第二,我们得出一个确切的有条件的、指向性的特征,从而减少了对在监督下学习标准化能源引起的指向修正的贬低。 第三,物理迁移概率流取消了高斯语的参考术语,并且通过高斯语的调制可以进行有变化的测量分期抽样,而无需再培训. 关于合成PDE系统和现实世界信息化应用的实验表明,物理数据交换支持连贯的实地恢复和高效取样,同时在试验噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断,说明其对实地评估的实际价值。 据我们所知,PhysDEM是第一个物理学定义的传播模型,它能够进行分期分期地推论,而无需预先组装全场数据集。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields is essential for scientific modeling. To address this task, generative artificial intelligence uses neural networks to learn probability distributions over plausible field realizations and generate new fields by sampling from these distributions. Diffusion models, in particular, generate samples from high-dimensional distributions through iterative denoising ( Song et al., 2020 ) . Their key strengths include training stability, sample fidelity, distributional coverage ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) , and flexible conditioning ( Song et al., 2020 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) , supporting the generation of spatially detailed field ensembles that represent diverse temporal evolutions and their uncertainty ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 产生并预测spatiotemporal物理场对科学建模至关重要. 为了完成这项任务,基因人工智能利用神经网络来学习概率分布在可能存在的场面实现上,并通过从这些分布中取样来产生出新的场. 特别是分化模型通过迭代去诺化产生高维分化的样本(Song等,2020.). 他们的主要长处包括训练稳定性、样本忠诚度、分布覆盖(Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021年)和灵活调节(Song等, 2020年;Rozet & Louppe, 2023年),支持形成空间详细、代表不同时间演变及其不确定性的场会(Price等, 2025年;Rozet & Louppe, 2023年)。

blocks.en: Most existing diffusion models for physical-field generation are data-driven . Some learn physical patterns implicitly from extensive reanalysis or simulation datasets ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ) , whereas others explicitly incorporate governing partial differential equations (PDEs) through physics-informed training losses ( Bastek et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or sampling guidance ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Jacobsen et al., 2025 ) . Both strategies typically rely on large collections of complete fields for training. This dependence limits their applicability when the available data consist only of scarce measurements, with time series recorded at a handful of spatial locations. These scarce measurements alone are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields.
blocks.zh: 现有的物理场生成传播模型大多由数据驱动。 有些人从广泛的再分析或模拟数据集(Price等人,2025;Rozet & Louppe,2023;)中隐含地学习了物理规律,而另一些人则通过物理知识训练损失(Bastek等人,2025;Wang等人,2026)或取样指导(Huang等人,2024;Jacobsen等人,2025;)明确纳入对部分微分方程的管理。 这两项战略通常依靠大量收集的完整栏目进行培训。 这种依赖性限制了其适用性,因为现有数据仅由稀缺的测量数据组成,在少数空间地点记录的时间序列。 仅靠这些稀缺的测量不足以说明整个田地的分布情况。

blocks.en: To address this limitation, we propose a physics-driven diffusion framework for spatiotemporal field generation, in which physics defines the target distribution, and measurements provide constraints . We use the governing equations to define a PDE residual energy and construct a target distribution from which we sample training fields, without requiring a preassembled full-field dataset from real-world measurements or external simulators. Once trained, the model serves as an amortized sampler, using scarce measurements at a handful of spatial locations to rapidly estimate unobserved field values and explore diverse plausible evolutions of complete spatiotemporal fields.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一限制,我们提出了一个物理学驱动的传播框架,用于空间场生成,其中物理学定义了目标分布,测量提供了制约。 我们使用管理方程式来定义PDE剩余能量,并构建一个目标分布,我们从中取样训练场,而不需要从现实世界的测量或外部模拟器中预先组装出全场数据集. 该模型经过培训后,成为分期摊还的采样者,利用少数空间地点的稀有测量方法,迅速估算未观测到的场值并探索完全瞬间场的各种可能演变。

blocks.en: Specially, we introduce PhysDEM , Phys ics- D efined E nergy- M atching Diffusion, for spatiotemporal field generation under scarce measurements. Our mathematical derivation links the PDE residual energy to target distribution construction, denoiser training, and field sampling. In this framework, we define a Gibbs target distribution by reweighting a Gaussian reference that encodes assumed field variability with the PDE residual energy that promotes physical consistency. We then derive an energy-determined conditional-mean diffusion denoiser that implements energy matching by learning the remaining energy-induced mean correction, aligning denoiser training with the physics-defined target. At inference, scarce measurements update the Gaussian reference and denoiser inputs. The denoiser’s predicted mean correction drives our physics-displacement probability-flow sampler , enabling amortized sampling of plausible complete spatiotemporal fields across measurement configurations without retraining. Our main contributions are as follows:

Denoiser的预测平均校正驱动着我们的物理迁移概率-流取样本器, 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose a physics-defined and measurement-constrained Gibbs target distribution that enables denoiser training on internally sampled complete fields without requiring a preassembled full-field dataset from real-world measurements or external simulators. • We mathematically derive an energy-determined conditional-mean diffusion denoiser through an exact conditional-mean identity, establishing energy matching as supervised learning of the energy-induced mean correction relative to an analytic Gaussian estimate. • We develop an amortized physics-displacement probability-flow sampler that analytically cancels Gaussian reference terms and uses the learned normalized correction as its velocity, accommodating changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning without retraining.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative artificial intelligence models support spatiotemporal field generation by learning distributions over plausible field realizations. GANs such as DGMR generate realistic precipitation sequences but rely on large radar archives for training ( Ravuri et al., 2021 ) . PI-GAN incorporates governing equations and ensembles of scattered sensor measurements but remains susceptible to discriminator overfitting ( Yang et al., 2020 ) . FNOPE uses conditional flow matching for function-valued posterior inference but requires paired parameter samples and simulator outputs ( Moss et al., 2025 ) . In comparison, diffusion offers an alternative based on non-adversarial denoising and flexible conditioning ( Song et al., 2020 ) , iteratively refining noisy fields according to learned spatiotemporal dependencies to generate spatially detailed, temporally coherent, and diverse fields ( Price et al., 2025 ; Rozet & Louppe, 2023 ; Rühling Cachay et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 基因人工智能模型通过学习分布于可能实现的场面,支持spatiotopal场地生成. DGMR等GAN生成现实的降水序列,但依靠大型雷达档案进行训练(Ravuri等,2021年). PI-GAN纳入了分散传感器测量的规范方程式和组合,但仍容易造成歧视者过度适应(Yang等人,2020年)。 FNOPE对函数值后推论使用有条件的流比,但需要配对参数样本和模拟输出(Moss等,2025.). 相比之下,传播提供了一种基于非对抗性的去诺和灵活条件的替代办法(Song等人,2020年),根据所学的spatiental依赖性,迭代地提炼出吵闹的场,以产生空间详细、时间一致和多样的场(Price等人,2025年;Rozet & Louppe,2023年;Rühling Cachay等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Physical constraints can enter diffusion models through PDE residual penalties during training ( Bastek et al., 2025 ) or guidance during sampling ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches generally rely on full-field training data obtained from measurements or forward simulations. A learned-physics approach ( Tan et al., 2026 ) estimates dynamics from observations without fully specified governing equations, but has not been demonstrated for full-field inference from scarce measurements alone. Energy-based diffusion samplers instead learn to sample from prescribed unnormalized densities without precomputed target datasets ( Vargas et al., 2023 ; Akhound-Sadegh et al., 2024 ) , but their original formulations do not explicitly support reuse across varying measurement counts without retraining. Compared with these state-of-the-art methods, PhysDEM provides a physics-defined diffusion framework that samples its own training fields from a PDE-based target and generates complete fields from scarce measurements while accommodating different measurement counts without retraining (see Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We develop PhysDEM for spatiotemporal field generation from scarce measurements without external full-field datasets. Extensive experiments show coherent field recovery, efficient sampling, and stable diagnostics under tested noise levels. Gaussian conditioning enables amortized sampling with changing measurements without retraining, while site-informed cases illustrate real-world value. Weakly informed static fields retain broad uncertainty, limiting unique recovery. Future work will use richer measurements to improve joint static and dynamic field recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了PhysDEM, 用于在没有外部全域数据集的情况下从稀缺的测量中进行瞬间场相生成. 广泛的实验表明,现场恢复是连贯的,取样效率高,在试验噪音水平下诊断是稳定的。 高斯式调制使得在不进行再培训的情况下用变化的测量方法进行分期抽样,而地点信息化案例则说明了现实世界的价值。 信息薄弱的静态领域仍然存在着广泛的不确定性,限制了独特的恢复。 今后的工作将使用更丰富的测量方法来改进联合静态和动态的实地恢复。

blocks.en: The analysis concerns the finite-dimensional field representation in Section 3.1 . blocks.en: This transport case incorporates field information from the USGS crude-oil spill research site near Bemidji, Minnesota ( Trost et al., 2018 ) . The data comprise 147 benzene records from 38 wells over seven campaigns between 1986 and 1995. Site geometry, well locations, campaign times, and a regional flow estimate inform the problem construction. The advection–diffusion equation ( 96 ) uses site-specific coefficients, a known regional streamfunction plus a scaled unknown perturbation, and an unknown source field. The records inform the source and reference construction, and a forward solve generates the concentration reference. Conditioning values are synthetic noisy measurements at real well locations and campaign times, yielding 56 values at K = 8 K=8 . Comparison with the 147 records therefore assesses agreement with the source data; it is descriptive rather than an independent held-out validation.

blocks.en: The eight baselines are task-adapted implementations, summarized in Table 4 . Their learned modules use 4,096 complete training fields and 512 validation fields per case, sampled approximately from the fixed physics-defined target.
